name: Framework-neutral private menu management workspace/controller boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
boundary: Inject only FoodPrivateMenuService; wrap all 23 existing operations and add exactly one bounded exact-offer/current-availability aggregate. Existing authority files remain unchanged.

factory.construction: Synchronous, I/O-free, zero service calls; return a frozen controller. No repository, resolver, administrator, database, environment or HTTP/request dependency is injected or exposed.
factory.inputValidation: Structural service validation only: require a non-null non-array object with all 23 required callable methods. Missing/malformed service or throwing property access causes TypeError with fixed message: Private food menu workspace configuration is unavailable. Never invoke methods during construction.

controller.wrapperSignatures: Preserve Parameters<FoodPrivateMenuService[K]> exactly for each explicitly named wrapper. Inputs are already-typed domain/service values; no narrower parsing wrappers or renamed tasks.
authorization: Controller call -> FOOD-002E service -> fresh authorization -> repository/domain behavior. FOOD-002E is sole authorization authority.
No payload prevalidation, ID parsing, version normalization, mutation-input inspection for feedback before success, duplicate principal/admin checks, cached authorization or permission inheritance.

Forward original argument references/order and optional undefined arguments; preserve service method receiver. No trim, normalization, generated IDs/versions/observation revisions, merging or automatic retries.
Unauthorized callers receive no extra validation/existence information from controller behavior.

resultTypes.FoodMenuWorkspaceResult<T>: Readonly<{ ok: true; value: T }> | Readonly<{ ok: false; error: Readonly<{ code: FoodMenuServiceErrorCode; message: string }> }>
resultTypes.FoodMenuWorkspaceMutation<T>: Readonly<{ outcome: 'created' | 'already-present'; snapshot: T; message: string; publicationLabel?: string }> | Readonly<{ outcome: 'conflict'; message: string }>
resultTypes.FoodMenuWorkspaceRead<T>: Readonly<{ outcome: 'found'; snapshot: T; message: string; publicationLabel?: string }> | Readonly<{ outcome: 'not-found'; message: string }>
resultTypes.FoodMenuWorkspacePage<T, C>: Readonly<{ items: readonly T[]; nextCursor?: C; message?: 'No snapshots returned.' }>
resultTypes.FoodMenuWorkspaceOfferDetail: Readonly<{ outcome: 'not-found'; message: 'No snapshot recorded.' }> | Readonly<{ outcome: 'found'; snapshot: FoodServingOffer; message: 'Snapshot found.'; availability: Readonly<{ state: 'not-recorded' }> | Readonly<{ state: 'recorded'; observation: FoodServingOfferAvailability }> }>
resultTypes.publicationLabelHelper: Export pure getFoodMenuPublicationWorkspaceLabel(state: FoodMenuPublication['state']) returning exactly 'Publication snapshot: unpublished' or 'Publication snapshot: published'. Use only on successful returned snapshots; never on submission before service authorization. No state normalization. This helper allows labels for page snapshots without a second summary schema.

feedback.access-unavailable: Food menu access could not be checked.
feedback.invalid-input: The food menu operation input is invalid.
feedback.storage: Food menu storage is unavailable. Reconcile the result before retrying.
feedback.conflict: A different version already exists. Refresh and reconcile before retrying.

presentationRules: Preserve all five FOOD-002E failure codes; replace messages with fixed workspace feedback. Service throws/rejections, malformed result/presentation failures map fixed storage. Never expose service/repository messages, exceptions, stacks, serialized payloads, principal/admin IDs or private FOOD-001 evidence in errors.

Preserve created/already-present/conflict; remove internal conflict reason. Success snapshot comes only from service result, never submitted input. No submitted payload is retained or echoed in failures or conflict feedback.
Preserve found/not-found and exact snapshots. No deletion implication. Direct availability reads preserve not-found rather than inventing a state.

Pages preserve exact ordered typed snapshots, cursor and omitted optional fields. Empty successful page gets fixed empty feedback; nonempty page omits message. Failed lists never become successful empty lists. Do not add a second summary/domain schema.

Successful publication mutation/read with snapshot adds publicationLabel from that snapshot's exact state. Page items remain unchanged snapshots; future UI can use the pure label helper. Underlying unpublished/published remains unchanged.
Publication labels never mean live, activated, publicly available, orderable, route existence, public visibility, active checkout or legal/safety/tax/payment/fulfillment readiness.
Availability keeps exact offer ID/version, observation revision and domain state. No inheritance, synthesis or conversion of absence into unavailable/sold-out/paused.
serviceResultValidation: Validate returned envelopes only after calling the service. Require non-null non-array objects with exactly own ok/value (literal true) or ok/error (literal false); reject unexpected keys including symbols and throwing access.
Failure error has exactly code/message, recognized one of five service codes and string message; replace message. Unknown/malformed error is storage.

Validate operation-family success envelope: created/already-present with non-null non-array snapshot; conflict with reason different-content; found with snapshot; not-found without snapshot; page items array and optional correctly typed cursor. Reject unexpected/missing envelope fields and unknown discriminants. Do not rerun domain validation or parse operation input.

Returned numeric cursors must be positive safe integers; identity cursors must be strings. FOOD-002E remains canonical cursor validation authority; F does not parse IDs. Page items must be non-null non-array objects. Publication presentation accepts only returned unpublished/published state; other states map storage.
All unexpected result/access/clone errors fail closed as fixed storage; return no malformed or partial payload.
offerWorkspaceDetail: First service.getOffer(offerId, offerVersion) with unchanged inputs. Map service failure; not-found returns successful not-found with neutral feedback and zero availability calls.

For found offer, verify snapshot.offerId and snapshot.version strictly equal requested coordinates. Mismatch maps fixed storage with zero availability calls. No canonical input parsing before service.
Then service.getCurrentAvailability(offerId, offerVersion), a separate freshly authorized operation. No reused decision, token or cache.
Second-call failure fails entire aggregate with no partial offer detail. not-found gives availability { state: 'not-recorded' }.

Found observation must have observation.offer.offerId and observation.offer.version strictly equal requested coordinates; mismatch maps fixed storage. Return availability { state: 'recorded', observation } preserving exact revision/state.
Never substitute latest offer, another offer version or another availability stream.

This is not an atomic database snapshot: the two authorized reads may observe different moments. Revocation between calls must be honored; this sequential consistency model is accepted for this slice.
immutability: All successful result envelopes, snapshots, mutation/read/page/aggregate presentation, observations and feedback objects are recursively detached and deeply frozen; controller and failure envelopes are frozen too.
No caller-owned mutable input or service-returned reference is retained in returned state. Source mutation after return cannot affect workspace output.

Deterministic cloning preserves array order, omitted optional fields, explicit undefined optional properties, unknown values and exact historical references. No timestamps/random IDs/global state or external I/O.
deferred: Publication preview: projectFoodPublicMenu needs exact FOOD-001 product/recipe contextual snapshots not exposed by FoodPrivateMenuService. A later authorized resolution boundary must bound/deduplicate exact historical reads, define availability selection and remain private/non-live. No borrowed unauthorized draft dependencies.

Dish plus all offers: FOOD-002D/E lack complete dish-filtered enumeration. Never filter one bounded general page and claim completeness. A future explicit repository/service query is required if needed.
Menu-specific gate/transport, runtime acquisition, infrastructure/admin activation and route/UI integration remain separate later slices.
sourceIsolation: No direct FoodMenuRepository, FOOD-001 repository, SessionPrincipalResolver, administrator principal or database/runtime configuration import/use. Authority is behind injected FoodPrivateMenuService.
No Request, FormData, URLSearchParams, cookies, headers, redirects, Astro context or HTTP/body parsing.
No delete/overwrite/update-in-place/reset/history rewrite/publish-live/activate-menu/make-orderable/checkout/payment/refund operations. Corrections are new versions/observations through FOOD-002E.
requiredTests: Construction synchronous, zero service calls, frozen controller; malformed/noncallable/throwing service configuration gives fixed sanitized TypeError.
All 23 wrappers forward exact arguments and receiver, no validation/normalization/generation before service; poisoned unauthorized payloads remain untouched.
created/already-present/conflict fixed feedback, conflict reason removed, success snapshot from service; found/not-found neutral feedback; empty/nonempty ordered pages and cursor preservation.
All five failure mappings, throws/rejections/malformed envelopes/throwing getters to storage; no internal message leakage, submitted payload retention or successful empty-list fallback.
Both publication labels exact, underlying states preserved, never live/activated/orderable; page label helper requires no second summary schema.
Direct exact observation/current not-found, absence remains absence, independent offer-version streams, no inheritance.

Aggregate exact offer plus observation, offer plus not-recorded, not-found/first failure/mismatched offer zero second calls, second failure no partial result, mismatched observation storage, no latest substitution.
Two service operations authorize freshly; real FOOD-002E revocation between reads honored with zero second repository access.
All returned nested results detached/deeply frozen; mutable service-returned source changes cannot change output; order/unknown/optional/reference semantics preserved.
Exactly 23 wrappers plus one aggregate; no destructive/public/payment authority, direct repository/resolver/admin access or excluded source dependency.
validation: Relevant FOOD-001I controller and identity regressions
Strict TypeScript checks for planned files
laterSequence: FOOD-002D D1 adapter and migration definition with isolated integration tests
Menu-specific gate and mutation transport if private HTTP bodies must remain unread before authorization
currentAuthorization: Create only this specification. Do not implement, stage, commit, configure infrastructure, access configured D1, migrate or deploy.
